title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Payer Conversion Credit: Computation and Entry
content:
**Revenue cycle credit standard — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.**

**1. Which agreements are figured under this standard.** Advance room and board billed for days on or after the conversion date is credited with the payer-conversion reason, and every such credit other than this conversion credit stays under that rule. This conversion credit is figured as below on an agreement whose stay's departure is on file or whose resident holds no hospital bed-hold reservation. On every other agreement the advance billed for days on or after the conversion date is credited with the payer-conversion reason at the daily rate of that charge, rounded to the cent, the conversion date being the first day another payer source took over the stay: the Part A coverage start date where the agreement is active again with Medicare Part A recorded as the payer source it was last converted to, the first day of the charge's span where it is active again with another payer source recorded and an earlier charge already carries a payer-conversion credit, and the conversion date recorded on the agreement otherwise.

**2. Records read.** For this credit, the Part A coverage episode read is the resident's episode whose booked days run latest, its booked block that begins latest deciding, read from the resident's **Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage** records. The stay's departure is the leave start date of the resident's hospital bed-hold reservation (**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations**), of any hospital kind and any status, whose leave began on that episode's qualifying hospital admission date, or else of the one returned on the Part A coverage start date, or else, where the resident holds exactly one hospital bed-hold reservation as counted below, of that reservation, a night in hospital observation counting as a night away. The resident's bed-hold reservations are counted kind by kind and status by status, the first reservation on file of each kind and status counting as one, and the count stands only where every bed-hold transfer notice on file names a counted reservation; the hospital kinds are the Medicaid hospital leave reserved bed, the private-pay hospital leave bed hold and the Medicare skilled-stay hospital leave bed hold.

**3. Amount.** The conversion credit equals the credited days times the conversion credit rate, plus the moved days times the moved-day rate, less the netted days times the netted per-day amount and less the netted amount of the other credits, the whole never below zero and rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure; where it is zero no entry is made. The credit is the credited days times the daily rate of that charge, rounded to the cent, for every discharge, death or conversion credit other than this conversion credit; only this conversion credit, on an advance charge billed for days the other payer source covered, nets out the earlier credits standing on the charge.

**4. Terms.**
- *Credited days* — the converted days plus the hospital days.
- *Conversion credit rate* — the daily rate of the conversion credit tier under the conversion credit schedule.
- *Converted days* — from the first converted day through the last day of the charge's span, or through the day before a move to another tier the agreement records on or after its conversion date inside that span, both days included; none where the first converted day falls after the day they stop.
- *First converted day* — the later of the conversion date recorded on the agreement and the first day of the charge's span.
- *Hospital days* — from the first hospital day through the day before the Part A coverage start date; none where there is no first hospital day or it does not fall before that date. No first hospital day is set, so the hospital days are none.
- *First credited day* — the first hospital day where there are hospital days, and the first converted day otherwise.
- *Entry* — against the charge with the payer-conversion reason, from the first credited day, with the credited days as its day count.
- *Moved days* — the days from the later of the move date and the first day of the charge's span through the day before the first credited day, on an agreement that records a move to another tier dated before its recorded conversion date where that later day falls before the first credited day; otherwise none. The moved-day rate is none.
- *Netted days* — the days of the late-notice credit on the charge, running consecutively from its first credited day, that fall on or after the first credited day and on or before the last converted day. *Netted amount of the other credits* — for each room-change or billing-error credit on the charge, its days running consecutively from its first credited day that fall in that same stretch, times its amount divided by its days.
- *Netted per-day amount* — the charge's daily rate, an earlier credit being taken to have removed whole days as a discharge, death or conversion credit does.
- *Conversion credit tier* — the agreement's own tier.
- *Conversion credit schedule* — the one in effect for the agreement on the first day of the charge's span: the current private pay schedule once the agreement's rate notice had run the rate change notice days by that day and the span begins on or after the current schedule's effective date, 1 July 2026, and the preceding schedule otherwise.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical worked example.** A 30-day advance span of an agreement in the Private Secure Memory Care Room priced at 465.00, a recorded conversion on its 11th day, no move, no earlier credits: converted days 11 to 30, 20 days; 20 times 465.00 is 9,300.00, entered from day 11 for 20 days. Had the charge carried a late-notice credit of 30 days from day 1, its days 11 to 30, 20 days, would be netted at the charge's daily rate.
